verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for a backend platform like Convex, so the axis applies, but the pack has no first-party evidence of scoped or least-privilege tokens or keys. The MCP server's default block on production deployments is an adjacent safety control, not credential issuance. The suggestion to check a shared secret from an environment variable is a developer building block for constructing your own scheme, so neither earns credit.
